leading_candidate_under_attack: M5_REFINED — Patient-specific sleep-state venous-pressure-aware adaptive drainage
attack_doctrine_note: Per push-the-envelope doctrine: 'Every apparent success must generate a harder attack. Every apparent failure must be audited for model inadequacy before becoming a ceiling.' First attack identifies the strongest plausible alternative to M5_REFINED and attempts to destroy the candidate.
attack_statement: M5_REFINED (sleep-state adaptive drainage with patient-specific venous pressure calibration) is a marginal extension of VIEshunt (2025, Fluids and Barriers of the CNS), which already teaches an intelligent electromechanical shunt with IMU + posture-specific ICP references (12 mmHg supine, -3 mmHg upright) tested in ovine model. A PHOSITA would extend VIEshunt's posture-specific ICP references to include circadian/sleep-state variation. The eShunt-specific venous pressure angle is a marginal extension of VIEshunt's ICP-aware control — both use pressure-aware drainage modulation. The 'patient-specific calibration' element is also taught by VIEshunt (posture-specific references are individualized to the patient). Therefore M5_REFINED is anticipated or rendered obvious by VIEshunt 2025.
attack_strength_assessment: STRONG — VIEshunt (2025) is a direct competitor smart shunt paper published in a peer-reviewed journal. It teaches IMU + pressure sensor + posture-specific ICP references + micro pump + wireless communication + tested in ovine model. The paper is recent (2025) and would be §102/§103 prior art for any new shunt adaptive control patent.

defense_1_eShunt_specific_venous_physiol.claim: VIEshunt teaches VENTRICULAR ICP measurement and posture-specific ICP references. It does NOT teach measurement or compensation of VENOUS SINUS PRESSURE — the unique eShunt anatomical feature.
defense_1_eShunt_specific_venous_physiol.supporting_evidence: eShunt drains CSF from ventricles/subarachnoid space DIRECTLY into the venous sinus. The drainage driving pressure is (P_CSF - P_venous). During sleep apnea, venous congestion raises P_venous 5-15 mmHg, REDUCING the drainage driving pressure. This is a UNIQUE eShunt physiological mechanism not present in VP shunts (which drain to peritoneum, where sleep-state venous pressure is irrelevant) or VIEshunt (which appears to measure ventricular ICP only, not venous sinus pressure).
defense_1_eShunt_specific_venous_physiol.verification_required: V2 passage-level audit of VIEshunt (2025) paper to confirm it does NOT measure or compensate for venous sinus pressure.

defense_2_patient_specific_calibration_o.claim: VIEshunt uses population-level posture-specific ICP references (12 mmHg supine, -3 mmHg upright are generic). M5_REFINED proposes PATIENT-SPECIFIC calibration of individual sleep-state venous pressure profile (collected over 1-7 day monitoring period post-implantation). This is a fundamentally different control paradigm: population-level references vs individual patient-specific trajectory.
defense_2_patient_specific_calibration_o.supporting_evidence: VIEshunt paper reports population-level references in their Methods section. Patient-specific calibration would require a learning phase post-implantation, which is NOT taught by VIEshunt (VIEshunt uses pre-set references, not learned ones).
defense_2_patient_specific_calibration_o.verification_required: V2 passage-level audit of VIEshunt Methods/Results to confirm references are population-level, not patient-specific learned.

defense_3_sleep_apnea_venous_congestion_.claim: M5_REFINED explicitly compensates for sleep apnea-induced venous congestion (a documented physiological phenomenon with clinically significant magnitude: 5-15 mmHg venous pressure rise during apneic episodes). This is a SPECIFIC compensation mechanism NOT taught by VIEshunt (which uses generic posture references, not sleep apnea detection).
defense_3_sleep_apnea_venous_congestion_.supporting_evidence: Sleep apnea is highly prevalent in hydrocephalus/IIH populations (40-60% comorbidity). Venous congestion during apnea is well-documented in sleep medicine literature. VIEshunt does NOT mention sleep apnea or apnea-specific compensation in its paper title or abstract.
defense_3_sleep_apnea_venous_congestion_.verification_required: V2 passage-level audit of VIEshunt paper body to confirm absence of sleep apnea compensation.

defense_4_chronic_disease_progression_in.claim: M5_REFINED's patient-specific calibration can be RE-CALIBRATED over months to track disease progression (e.g., NPH symptoms improving, IIH resolving with weight loss). VIEshunt's population-level references are STATIC (set once at implantation).
defense_4_chronic_disease_progression_in.supporting_evidence: Patient-specific learning trajectory over time is a fundamentally different control paradigm from static population references.
defense_4_chronic_disease_progression_in.verification_required: V2 audit of VIEshunt paper to confirm references are static, not adaptive over time.

defense_summary: M5_REFINED survives ATTACK_1 CONDITIONALLY. The eShunt-specific venous pressure compensation + patient-specific learned calibration + sleep apnea-specific compensation collectively distinguish M5_REFINED from VIEshunt. However, the survival is CONDITIONAL on V2 passage-level audit confirming that VIEshunt does NOT measure venous sinus pressure, does NOT use patient-specific learned references, and does NOT compensate for sleep apnea.
conditions_for_survival: V2 passage-level audit of VIEshunt (2025) confirms no venous sinus pressure measurement/compensation
V2 passage-level audit of VIEshunt (2025) confirms population-level (not patient-specific learned) ICP references
V2 passage-level audit of VIEshunt (2025) confirms no sleep apnea-specific compensation mechanism
honest_negative_finding_from_attack: M5_REFINED is NOT clearly novel against VIEshunt. The basic posture-adaptive drainage mechanism is partially saturated. Survival depends entirely on the eShunt-specific venous pressure angle + patient-specific learned calibration + sleep apnea compensation. If V2 audit reveals any of these elements in VIEshunt's paper body (not just abstract), M5_REFINED would be DESTROYED and would need to pivot to M8 (closed-loop non-invasive ICP proxy) or a hybrid mechanism.
next_attacks_planned_for_v2: ATTACK_2: Single-sensor unidentifiability attack — can a single IMU + pressure sensor distinguish sleep state from other supine activities?
ATTACK_3: Sleep apnea detection reliability attack — can sleep apnea be reliably detected from eShunt's sensors without dedicated SpO2/PSG?
ATTACK_4: Patient-specific calibration burden attack — is 1-7 day calibration period acceptable to patients/clinicians?
ATTACK_5: Comparator attack vs M8 — head-to-head: is M5_REFINED's venous-pressure-aware adaptation superior to M8's non-invasive ICP proxy feedback?
